CREATE TABLE threads (
        thread_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        cwd TEXT,
        mode TEXT,
        state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',

        last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,
